findings.finding: Original interludes use illustrated people with proportioned faces, strongly modeled light/shadow, textured layered settings, varied close-ups and wide inserts. Candidate uses repeated plastic blocks, bare rooms, pole birches and front-facing mannequin groups. More native parts alone will not close the visual-language gap.
findings.patch: Approve a new original-art style pilot before bulk production. See originalArtDirection.

findings.finding: Large permanent title band, progress/speaker row and four full-width colored transport buttons dominate compact composition. Original interlude reference shows images/subtitles with black margins and no persistent chapter dashboard. Sky/CoreGui/health band stays exposed above scene.
findings.patch: Use quiet image-led letterboxing; reveal transport on input/pause, preserve accessible44px interaction targets when visible, reserve measured caption lane. Move chapter title to a short intro/interstitial. Coordinate UIREF-D04/UIREF-08 with integrator, not a blanket blue HUD token pass over story art. Keep Roblox system access available; control inset/safe-area deliberately.

findings.finding: Obvious maroon overlay at compact i01-b4,i03-b2,i05-b1,i09-b4; weaker warm/red wash at i03-b4. It affects CoreGui icons/health, title, captions and buttons as well as ViewportFrame. Thus it cannot be explained solely by per-shot ViewportFrame lighting.
findings.cause: UNPROVEN. Existing nearly-empty red health bar and screen-edge gradient make native character-health feedback a plausible hypothesis, not a diagnosis. CameraShake source uses a neutral white TintColor flash; no evidence that it produces this red overlay. No engine reproduction allowed/performed.
findings.patch: Integrator should inspect character health/damage and CoreGui Health lifecycle during story mounting alongside GUI overlay stack and camera effects. Separate cinematic from active damage updates; restore prior state on finish/cancel. Do not blindly recolor scene palettes or globally disable player controls/CoreGui. Capture same shot before/after wait/pause and from clean campaign and isolated viewer to isolate scope.
findings.sourceInspectionLimit: CameraShake.ts is a read-only live-source clue, not an engine reproduction or separate hash-certified frozen feedback-module review. Story/caption/cinematic files are hash-matched; concurrent UI/controller edits are excluded.
